## Dictate Prompt
- **Your quick prompts keep their order.** If you set up your own quick prompts, the card (⌘2) lists them in the order from Settings, so ⌃1, ⌃2 and so on always run the same prompt. Three rows are visible, and the rest scroll or are reachable with ⌃4–⌃9. The prompt you used last is highlighted.

## Claude & AI apps
- **Claude Desktop connects without Node.js.** "Connect" now links Claude Desktop directly to WhisperShortcut, so you no longer need to install Node.js.
- **AI apps can manage your quick prompts.** Claude and other AI apps connected via MCP can read and change your Dictate Prompt quick prompts, and Settings shows the change right away.
- **More changes ask first.** With "Make changes directly" selected, running a Dictate Prompt, rewriting text for Read Aloud, changing a model and taking screen context now always wait for your approval.
- Configuration files that WhisperShortcut writes for AI apps can only be read by your user account.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.81...v8.82
